title: Boy Meets Girl: Say Hello to Courtship
author: Joshua Harris
target_audience: Individuals interested in faith-based relationship guidance
Parents and church leaders advising youth
Couples considering dating or courtship with purpose
core_themes: Biblical approach to relationships and dating
The concept and practice of courtship
Communication, trust, and discernment in relationship building
primary_purpose: To offer Christian singles an alternative to traditional dating by promoting courtship as a purposeful and God-honoring path to romantic relationships, emphasizing intentionality, spiritual growth, and emotional purity.

structure_format.organization: Chapters tell real-life stories, interweave scriptural guidance, and provide practical advice
features: Personal anecdotes from the author and others
Study questions for groups or individuals
Practical tips for relationship discernment and boundaries

key_concepts_lessons: Modern dating often lacks intentionality and can encourage physical and emotional pitfalls.
Courtship involves pursuing relationships with purpose, seeking God’s will and direction.
Guarding one’s heart and emotions is as important as physical boundaries.
Open communication and accountability with trusted mentors/family are vital.
Waiting on God’s timing can strengthen character and discernment.
Romantic relationships should ultimately point toward marriage and spiritual growth.
notable_features: Christian perspective on dating and relationships
Includes thought-provoking questions for discussion or personal reflection
Focuses on practical steps for courtship
Addresses both the emotional and physical sides of romantic pursuit
cultural_historical_context: Published at the turn of the 21st century, during a surge in Christian literature addressing purity and romantic relationships, following up the popularity of Joshua Harris’s earlier book 'I Kissed Dating Goodbye.' Written in response to concerns about cultural approaches to dating and sexuality among Christian youth.
reception_impact: Widely read and discussed in evangelical Christian communities
Influential in shaping Christian courtship movements in North America
Praised for its sincerity and practical application of faith to relationships
Later revisited critically—including by the author himself—regarding the effects of its teachings on Christian youth and attitudes about dating
comparable_titles: I Kissed Dating Goodbye by Joshua Harris
When God Writes Your Love Story by Eric and Leslie Ludy
Passion and Purity by Elisabeth Elliot
Boundaries in Dating by Henry Cloud and John Townsend
